jvmti.h is the unmodified generated OpenJDK 21 JVMTI interface header,
obtained from the locally installed JDK 21.0.12.1+1.
The client requests JVMTI_VERSION_1_2 and uses only APIs available in Java 8+.
It does not link to a particular JVM library at build time.

The header carries GPLv2 with the Classpath exception. See LICENSE-jvmti.txt
and ADDITIONAL_LICENSE_INFO-jvmti.txt.
